title: Latest TicWatch Pro does not work reliably, as a Standalone Collector
symptom: TicWatch Pro does not work reliably as a standalone collector. It stays running in standalone mode for between 2 to 12 hours at best, then stops collecting, always losing connection overnight. Restarting the collector on the watch resumes it temporarily.
cause: The main problem seems to be that the TicWatch is handled/recognized as a Bluetooth headset.
evidence_quote: The main problem seem to be that the TicWatch is handled/recognized as a Bluetooth headset.
